head: Qwen3-8B opened the hidden link when the list gave its words, and almost never when the list gave only addresses
sub: Same agent (Qwen3-8B, reasoning mode on), same pricing page, one run each. Only the link list differs. The totals below come from {NRUNS} runs per list on {NSITES} test websites.
qa: Question: “Does a two-factor law, reach(tool) × follow(model, format), fitted on half the cells, predict every held‑out cell within 10 points for local open‑weight agents once the link list carries anchor text?” (Reach: how often the tool shows the hidden link. Follow: how often the model then opens it. Cell: one agent with one page format. Anchor text: the link's words.) Answer: Not settled. The law missed one held‑out cell, {WHO} on {FMT}, by {MISS} points (predicted {PRED}, measured {CATCH}; 95% interval {LO} to {HI}). To call the law wrong, our frozen test needed the whole interval beyond 10.
key: Saw address: the link's random code was in what the tool returned. Requested: our server logged a visit to that address.
foot: Test websites we built; gpt-oss-20b and Qwen3-8B run locally, Nov 23 2026
